A3 Methodology
The study employs a structured approach to 
estimate the GovTech market size (1) and its 
GovTech opportunity for the public sector (2) by 
2034. The methodology integrates an analysis of 
public sector IT spending, expert opinions and 
established models to produce reliable estimates 
of both market growth and societal impact.
1. Assessment of the GovTech market size
a. Determination of sector focus: Calculation 
of the market comprises four sectors: public 
services, education, healthcare/life sciences 
and transport.
b. Projecting IT spending: Growth projections 
extended to 2034 by applying the average 
annual growth rate of 8% (based on 2022-2028 
data) (see Figure 5).13,14
